checks.name: request-isolation
checks.scope: Fresh selected native routing/preferences/proxy/security tests exercise request-owned state and accepted/rejected policy; current public EN/BG cases use separate browser contexts and current HTTP tests preserve cookie boundaries.

checks.name: security-write-blocking
checks.scope: Fresh native security/policy tests and 16 HTTP preference-only guard checks; browser audit intercepts non-read business requests. This does not claim a clean dependency vulnerability audit or submit any dealership enquiry.
